visual_checks.name: tile_grid_seams
visual_checks.evidence: PNG MD5-identical to iter-045 best (hero/side/top all match).

reasoning: PNG bit-identical to iter-045 (MD5 match). Kernel 26.3485 → 26.372 ms (+0.07% — within measurement noise, treated as flat). The change fused B2a+B2b into ONE acquire with a SINGLE mul_tiles_init(CB_DX, CB_DX) shared by mul_tiles(CB_DX,CB_DX) AND mul_tiles(CB_DY,CB_DY) — the new safe pattern: ONE mul_tiles_init + multiple mul_tiles with DIFFERENT same-format CBs. Distinct from iter-039's MULTIPLE mul_tiles_init hang. Pattern is now PROVEN SAFE (kernel ran, output bit-identical). Perf is flat because we saved 1 acquire but the FPU ops dominate; the next iter (049) extending to 3-way (B2a+B2b+B2c) should show real win. KEEP for the pattern unlock — neutral perf but enables iter-049.
